# Asia Tech Review Bulletin

Asia Tech Review Bulletin is a public feed of Asia technology news items.

Machine-readable JSON Feed:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/feed.json

RSS/XML feed:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/rss.xml

Public website:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/

Public API index:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api

Versioned API:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/v1

Latest structured bulletin items:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/v1/items

OpenAPI schema:
https://bulletin.asiatechreview.com/api/openapi.json

The JSON feed contains recent structured bulletin items for simple ingestion. Prefer the API for stable machine-readable fields, item lookup, categories and search. Use source_url as the primary citation for each bulletin item instead of scraping the visual website.
